definition_used: Any question, controversy or dispute about references, citations, attributions, etc. This could include fabricated/falsified references, reference stacking, citing other work with an EOC or correction, etc.
semantic_rationale: The definition explicitly targets references, citations, and attributions, which directly maps to the attribution/authorship/disclosure integrity category. The process signal of content reuse or duplication is implied by reference stacking or citing corrected works, but the primary concern is attribution integrity.
